bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: strip SDK-auto-generated assembly attributes from copied AssemblyInfo.cs (keep ComVisible/InternalsVisibleTo) to prevent CS0579 duplicate-attribute build failures — recurs on every UWP project/sub-project.
MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: document CS0579 (legacy AssemblyInfo.cs) with the strip / GenerateAssemblyInfo=false fix as a backstop to the tooling change.
MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: document CS0118/CS0576 when RootNamespace shadows a WinRT type (sensor/device sample names) — fix with a distinct alias or global::, never a same-named alias.
